assessor.scope: Post-score diagnostics, inaccessible to participants; no score mutation. Confirm target and descriptor binding before screen decision.
assessor.consumer_policy: Overlay unchanged original tests read-only on actual exact proposal patch. Both original named consumers must pass; no changed assertion may substitute. Preserve warning-as-error and exact frozen commands.
assessor.setup_policy: Validate output JSON/log hash, expected outcome and exit consistency; 0 green, 42 behavioral red, other/missing/inconsistent = unsupported setup. Missing grades/meters are never zero.

full_original_modules.policy: Both full unchanged modules overlaid read-only; require 74 collected and all passing with exit 0. Collection errors, wrong denominator, unexpected exits or inconsistent states are unsupported setup, never pass.

mechanism: Before first production edit, existing brief states the condition unit over the response iterable and outside-scope homogeneous caller behavior; existing intent review accepts or corrects that actual mapping. No added reviewer or duplicate execution to score. Absence, wrong, late or equivalent parent with no decision difference fails mechanism.
acceptance: Both stream and warning scope probes and original consumer preservation and both full original modules (74/74) green, all native gates and final artifact review retained. Complete root plus transitive descendant costs: candidate strictly lower cost and shorter checkout-to-proposal than matched parent; ready full PR strictly higher than stock and complete proposal cost <= stock. Missing meter or review, equal cost or time, timeout, ties or lost behavior cannot pass. Retain all allocations and partials; separately meter assessor cost.
falsifier: Reject absent or late unit and preserved caller mapping, setup presented as behavior, any lost contract or full original module regression, missing required intent/artifact review, duplicate workflow, cost or wall time not strictly below matched parent, non-ready candidate, score tie/loss to stock or cost above stock. Missing proof is unsupported; retain partials.
scope: One exposed Werkzeug tuning case; no conditional new cases or promotion inference. Parent and stock prospective behavior unknown; Black already reasoned about bounds and is counterevidence to transfer.
assessment: Three independent blinded candidate/stock/merge rotations; prior soft PR quality unknown. Compare frozen and supplemental results separately; require genuine complete proposal state.
